{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
n_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
n_total = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = n_severe / n_total

print(f"Number of patients with severe baseline disease: {n_severe}")
print(f"Total number of enrolled patients: {n_total}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
